preserve_runtime: Constrain torch to importlib.metadata.version('torch'); do not replace the ROCm build.
parent_dispatch_qualification: uv run python compute/dispatch.py --lane-dir experiments/active_evidence --config experiments/active_evidence/mini.json --id active_evidence-mini-seed17 --gpus 1 --submit
parent_dispatch_screen: uv run python compute/dispatch.py --lane-dir experiments/active_evidence --config experiments/active_evidence/screen.json --id active_evidence-screen-seed17 --gpus 1 --submit
visibility: Dispatcher sets ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Runner leaves visibility untouched and requires exactly one visible GPU at cuda:0.

local_verification.tiny_cpu_adapter_gradient_and_reload: passed; finite decreasing loss, changed adapters, bitwise equal reloaded logits and unchanged base
local_verification.tokenizer_budget: 3840 distinct device/input prompts all exactly 130 input tokens; binary labels each one token
local_verification.rocm_qwen_training: GPU mini passed: 2 arms x 2 stages, nonzero parameter updates, identical initial adapters and training budgets, exact checkpoint logits after reload; qualification only

promotion_rule: Full screen requires held-out gain over untouched base, ability to learn the next skill, active-versus-random gain, relative retention/next-skill regressions <= 0.05, and own stable-task forgetting <= 0.05. A kept candidate still requires fresh-seed independent confirmation. Mini remains qualification only.
selection_boundary: Frozen base Qwen scores uncertainty from the current device's acquired evidence. The exact finite-family selector knows the public hypothesis family, but cannot access the true rule, unqueried labels, or held-out inputs. It is an oracle upper bound.
student_boundary: Only current-stage observed query labels enter supervised training. The stable old device receives no second-stage training. All primary evaluations clear evidence, disable cache, and evaluate saved/reloaded adapters.
limitations: One seed is a screen, not a robust effect estimate.
Synthetic binary rules do not establish general agentic learning.
The oracle selector has exact family knowledge and is not evidence of learned experiment design.
Forced-choice accuracy is accompanied by unrestricted next-token accuracy and answer-token probability mass.
resolved_review_findings: AE-001: absolute stable-task forgetting threshold added and verified with six CPU decision counterexamples

followup.proof_limit: Dataflow and matched-budget CPU proof; followup GPU learning not measured yet.
